title: Seoul festival draws record 142 producers of traditional Korean drinks
caption:
Seoul's massive traditional drink festival just hit a record 142 producers. The goal? Taking unique rice wines and spirits from local favorites to international exports.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul festival draws record 142 producers of traditional Korean drinks
